title: Bilanz zu gestrigen Versammlungen im Stadtgebiet

extraction.summaryEn: Police deployed about 800 officers at several political assemblies in Mitte, Gesundbrunnen, Wedding and Märkisches Viertel; 30 people were arrested and 22 criminal investigations opened. One police officer was hurt during a blockade at a party event on Eichhorster Weg.
